# Matt Greathouse

> The professional site and résumé of Matt Greathouse, a founding senior software engineer who builds AI agent systems and reliable full-stack products.

Matt Greathouse works across product engineering, LLM orchestration, browser automation, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, identity, and customer-facing software. The résumé is the most complete source for experience, skills, education, and contact information.

## Primary pages

- [Homepage](https://mattgreat.house/): Professional profile and current overview.
- [HTML résumé](https://mattgreat.house/resume/): Complete, indexable résumé with work history, skills, education, and contact information.
- [PDF résumé](https://mattgreat.house/matt-greathouse-resume.pdf): Original downloadable résumé.
- [Complete profile](https://mattgreat.house/llms-full.txt): Full machine-readable résumé and profile text.
